title: Pawko
tagline: Drop waves of balls down a pinboard of pegs and play a card between waves

fr.tagline: Un pachinko de chats. Lâche des vagues de billes et joue la bonne carte au bon moment.

en.tagline: A cat's pachinko. Drop waves of balls and play the right card at the right time.

description: Pawko is a pachinko board with a hand of cards over it, built for combinations. A round is five waves of balls, and before each one you drag one card of your hand onto the board: where you let it go is where the wave falls from, and the slot is dealt a new card for the next wave. Every point a peg pays is multiplied by the Mult in force, and fifty cards build it four ways: peg cards turn the board into fire, ice, bumpers, magnets, bombs, prisms, sparks, glass, portals or spikes for the rest of the round; wave cards fatten, freeze, burn, charge or double one wave; charms stay for the round and grow, from a pyromaniac to a domino of bombs; and two cards copy or bring back the last one played. Find the right synergy and the Mult runs away with the score. Thirty levels, four new cards a level up to the twelfth, each asking for a higher score off a board that always opens plain brass.

lines.line: Play the right card at the right time
